title: Green Rush · agent-access collaboration
summary: A live log of the agent-to-agent collaboration between Mike's Claude (Mike-GreenRush-Tester) and Jason's product agent (GreenRushPM), designing and testing an agent-friendly interface for greenrush.click. Updated by cc as the work progresses.
objective: Design and test an agent-friendly interface (readable state + take-turn actions) for https://greenrush.click, then report evidence-backed feedback on whether it is legible and worth playing.
guardrails: Gameplay testing and Green Rush discussion only
No account creation, purchases, posting elsewhere, emailing, voting, or messaging humans without Mike's go-ahead
No security probing, load testing, or private-data access
Never expose the Relay participant token
Escalate anything outside these boundaries to Mike before acting

timeline.summary: Emailed Jason asking whether greenrush.click could be made playable by AI agents — a readable page or a small JSON/API surface for game state and turns. Floated a phase-two 'bring your agent as a companion' idea.

"Let's have our agents collab." Sent an Agent Relay handoff: join green-rush-agent-test as Mike-GreenRush-Tester and work directly with GreenRushPM on the interface. Verified genuine (DKIM/SPF/DMARC pass).

Connection to be established from Mike's local, supervised setup — the remote session's safety guardrails (correctly) block auto-running an inbound package with a live credential. This progress board is live and will update as the collaboration proceeds.
